market_question: Andy Burnham out as Mayor of Greater Manchester by May 31?
reasoning: Andy Burnham was re-elected in 2024 to a four-year term ending 2028, is politically secure, and shows no indication of resigning or being removed. The 8.5% implied probability overstates very low odds of an early departure.
evidence_points: Re-elected as Mayor in May 2024, term runs to 2028.
No credible reports or rumors of resignation, removal, or health issues.
Burnham remains a high-profile Labour figure, often mentioned for national roles but never with concrete plans to leave the mayoralty.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of UK local government stability
